svg.title: GO bus network, captured 23 October 2026
svg.desc: A geographic view of the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area, with a smaller inset showing the full captured GO bus network. Dark green lines are operating-data geometry. Amber-centred markers identify selected reference hubs. The inset outline shows the main view. All 258 directional patterns in the 2026-10-23 feed are combined; they were not all scheduled to run simultaneously. Service dates represented: 2026-10-22 through 2026-11-27. The backdrop is modern Ontario mainland geography.
